newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics rise on Wall Street gains.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics rise on Wall Street gains.

text.p: Taiwan electronic shares continued to rise in early Tuesday trade after U.S. high-tech stocks led Wall Street's recent gains, brokers said.
After 40 minutes, with the overall index down a scant 0.07 percent, electronics were up 0.87 percent.
Holtek Microelectronics surged T$1.5, or 4.85 percent, to T$32.4 and Accton rose T$2.5, or 4.24 percent, to T$61.5.
"Local electronics have been strong for one month amid improving sales and profit performance," said Albert Lin of Golden Securities.
"After the sector's downward corrections late last week, it has now risen again, boosted in part by the gains of high-tech shares on Wall Street," Lin said.
Brokers said the rise in electronics shares had not come to an end.
